responsibility: This module is GCC’s language-independent diagnostics subsystem: it provides the core diagnostic_context engine and global reporting APIs for warnings, errors, notes, pedwarns, and internal errors; the source-location and rich-location infrastructure used to expand locations into annotated source snippets; and the pretty-printing, color, hyperlink, and text-art layers that control human-readable presentation. Its file groups also cover structured and alternate emission backends such as classic text, JSON, SARIF, and HTML, including the output-spec machinery for selecting sinks, buffering and output-file support, and libgdiagnostics for external clients building diagnostics through a public API. Beyond basic message emission, the module owns richer explanatory payloads such as execution paths, context paths derived from GIMPLE control flow, diagnostic diagrams, directed graphs and state graphs for analyzer-style reports, macro-expansion unwinding, metadata like CWE and violated rules, GCC-specific URLification, and spelling-suggestion helpers, as well as per-location warning-suppression state and the lightweight generator-side errors interface. Together these files define how GCC constructs, classifies, augments, formats, and emits diagnostics across front ends, middle-end analyses, and machine-readable tooling.
